name: Two Wheeler
description: Zero-maintenance VRLA AGM batteries for motorcycles and scooters across India.
longDescription: Engineered specifically for Indian road vibration and daily self-start commuter traffic. Goodwin Two-Wheeler SMF VRLA batteries feature spill-proof Absorbed Glass Mat (AGM) separators, high cold-cranking amps, and flexible 12, 18, and 48-month warranty plans.
highlights: Available in 12M, 18M, and 48M (24M Free + 24M Pro-Rata) Warranty Tiers
Direct OEM Fitment: GW-TZ4LB, GW-TZ5LB, GW-XL5LB & GW-XL2.5LC

name: Inverter & UPS
description: High-capacity Tall Tubular inverter batteries (150Ah–250Ah) and compact UPS backup solutions.
longDescription: Uninterrupted power backup for homes, offices, and commercial establishments. Choose from our heavy-duty 150Ah, 200Ah, and 250Ah Tall Tubular batteries backed by a 72-Month Warranty, or compact 12V 8Ah VRLA and Lithium-Ion computer UPS batteries.
highlights: Tall Tubular Series (150Ah, 200Ah, 250Ah) with 72 Months Warranty
Compact 12V 8Ah SMF VRLA & LiFePO4 Drop-In Computer UPS Batteries
Deep-Cycle High-Pressure Die-Cast Spines for Frequent Power Cuts

name: VRLA & SMF
description: Sealed maintenance-free VRLA and Gold Series batteries for UPS, scales, sprayers, toys, and emergency lighting.
longDescription: Versatile Valve Regulated Lead-Acid (VRLA) and Goodwin Gold Series batteries engineered for standby and cyclic equipment. Covers 4V, 6V, and 12V configurations for electronic weighing scales, medical equipment, emergency lamps, kids ride-on toys, and general industrial backup.
highlights: Complete 4V, 6V & 12V Industrial SMF and Gold Series Lineup
Leak-Proof Sealed Construction for Any Mounting Orientation
Deep Discharge Recovery for Cyclic & Standby Equipment

name: Agricultural Sprayers
description: Cyclic VRLA and ultra-lightweight Lithium-Ion batteries for agricultural knapsack sprayers and farm equipment.
longDescription: Purpose-built for continuous daily cyclic duty in agricultural knapsack sprayers, solar farm fencing, and portable rural equipment. Available in heavy-duty VRLA (12V 12Ah & 14Ah), Gold Series 14Ah, and featherlight 1.3 kg Lithium-Ion (LiFePO4) 12V 14Ah packs.
highlights: Dedicated 12V 14Ah VRLA, Gold Series & Lithium-Ion Sprayer Batteries
High Cyclic Endurance for Full-Day Field Spraying Operations
Lightweight 12V 14Ah LiFePO4 Option for Reduced Operator Fatigue

name: Lithium-Ion
description: Ultra-lightweight LiFePO4 lithium batteries with integrated BMS for UPS and agricultural sprayers.
longDescription: Next-generation Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) drop-in replacements that weigh up to 65% less than conventional lead-acid batteries while delivering 3x cycle life and rapid charge acceptance. Equipped with built-in multi-stage BMS protection.
highlights: Integrated Battery Management System (BMS) Against Overcharge & Short Circuit
Up to 65% Lighter Weight than Equivalent Lead-Acid Batteries
Direct Drop-In 12V 8Ah UPS and 12V 14Ah Agro Sprayer Packs
